primal_fractional_packing_certificate.feasibility_argument: A full-union pair fails a singleton-minimal filter F_ab only if a and b are split onto opposite exclusive sides. No two-sided split can make all three pairs among u1,u2,u3 bichromatic; equivalently K3 is not bipartite. Hence any legal pair covers at most two priced filters and has load at most 1.

dual_fractional_cover_certificate.feasibility_argument: Every relevant semi-filter contains both members of at least one listed relevance-witness pair. Upward closure then makes it fail at least two of P1,P2,P3, so it receives total dual cover weight at least 1.

verification.analytic_certificate: Matching feasible primal and dual objectives 3/2 prove the finite fractional optimum exactly by weak duality; no numerical optimizer is needed for the proof.

failure_separation.gluing_reason: A one-step equality does not establish a scale recurrence or root-facing lower bound.
